model_output:
```sql
WITH longest_freeway AS (
  SELECT 
    road_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    roads
  WHERE 
    highway = 'motorway'
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Oklahoma' AND border_type = 'state'))
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_freeway), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_freeway))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF') AS rast
  FROM 
    clipped_dem
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Stats(slope_raster.rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM 
    slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  longest_freeway.road_name,
  stats.mean AS average_slope
FROM 
  longest_freeway,
  slope_stats;
```
